name: Ignite the Soul deals 1 damage to target unit
notes: Ignite the Soul's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed. Its target pool is any object on the opponent's field (not filtered to ALLY/CHAMPION), so it targets the opponent's champion directly. The [Class Bonus] Floating Memory clause is a passive/reusable-elsewhere property, not a triggered ability, and is out of scope.
